question: Which exact read-only package-name lookup can resolve a currently registered QuickApp BIN icon without generating or modifying installed resources?
prototype_hypothesis: ARM AAPCS: const char *package in r0, borrowed app-record pointer or NULL in r0. UI-owner serialized read-only active-registry wrapper.
callsite_evidence: Exact AP wrapper at 0xc6a16a2, callable 0xc6a16a3, complete body length 10: 80b500af0bf00bf880bd; SHA256 a67024cd98157404fae905668a3cdf63c25e2411944f753d27b70b4d2df1d960. This evidence window is not an allowlist range.
Package-manager service slot 0x20084ec4 points to 0x2ca3da68; its slot 3 (+12) contains 0xc6a16a3. Slot 4 searches a different registry and is not used.

quickapp_register_app at 0xc582f90 stores descriptor package at +12 and generated icon pathname at +16. Active manager installation duplicates these strings; the launcher consumes the file-path source.
control_flow_evidence: Wrapper delegates to active package registry lookup using *0x20084ebc. Hashmap returns stored record on success and NULL on miss; lookup neither allocates nor transfers ownership.

Selected map bucket uses power-of-two count, DJB2 seed 5381 and NUL-inclusive key length; nodes contain key +4, length +8, record +12, next +16. Adapter bounds/readability-checks the selected bucket before native lookup.

Source-compiled ARM adapter runs the real exact AP wrapper, registry/hashmap/hash/bucket instructions on synthetic registries. The known strcmp thunk targets absent ROM 0x0026c095; only that leaf is explicitly modeled.

Module copies bounded package/icon strings and verifies exact package-root canonical lowercase BIN pathname. It never invokes quickapp_make_icon_url, PNG conversion, registration or filesystem writes.
ownership_analysis: App records and strings are borrowed manager-owned state; replacement/removal can free them. Serialized UI owner only, no IRQ/manager locks across the call, no pointers retained across owner turns. Coarse region/bucket guards and field rechecks do not establish allocation liveness or arbitrary concurrency safety.
unsafe_assumptions: No physical-device probe, installed-resource adoption, renderer or GPU success is claimed.
Lookup is only for initialized active registry entries; installed but unregistered packages may be absent. PNG/memory/non-file sources are unsupported.
Caller must honor owner serialization; native hashmap/ROM leaf behavior on hardware is not established by synthetic-registry emulation.
Exact callable registration only: no firmware address range expansion, verifier bypass, SDK export approval, transitive leaf allowlisting or .043 promotion.
recommended_probe: Run host adapter tests, fingerprinted AP instruction probes, exact positive/nearby/wrong-target/removal-control ELF verifier tests, then recoverable hardware tests for UI context, repeated reload, install/remove and same-path regeneration.

artifacts.role: independent exact target addresses, fingerprints and ownership audit
source-compiled host adapter guard and ownership tests
source-compiled production ARM and real AP lookup instruction probes with documented strcmp leaf
exact-address ELF acceptance and nearby/wrong-target/record-removal rejection controls
